description.value:
You create a terrifying ghost emoji that only the target can see. The target must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 2} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Stunned]{Stunned 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Fleeing], and it's @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Slowed]{Slowed 2} for as long as it remains frightened.
